29995 W Twelve Mile Rd
Farmington Hills, MI 48334
Tel: 248-699-6700
www.fhgov.com

Heritage Park features 211-acres of park land
with 4.5 miles of hiking trails. Amenities include
picnic shelters, playground, sand volleyball courts,
horseshoe pits, and grills. Also home to the Nature
Center, Stables Art Studio, Amphitheater, Splash
Pad, and Riley Archery Range.
